name: Tilly
source:
Lyle's best friend. This rowdy, outgoing, energetic girl seems to be the opposite of Lyle in every way! Tilly is impatient and blunt, never hesitating to speak her mind. She's incredible helpful when she's not running late. Tilly hates secrets more than anything else. Will Lyle tell her about the dolls? He may not have a choice!

[From [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/karitsa/doki-doki-dollmaker-a-heartfelt-bl-visual-novel]Kickstarter[/url]]
